message: You know that one friend who always seems to panic at the slightest hint of trouble? I think we all have a bit of that in us sometimes! That's why I found this resource on financial preparedness so helpful. It’s a gentle reminder that taking small steps now can really help us feel more secure later. Just like you wouldn’t leave home without an umbrella in the rain, it’s good to have a plan for our finances, too. What little steps do you take to keep things steady?
